items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Edge drawer on Base UI Drawer: slides from any side with the base yorha-slide-* utilities, swipe to dismiss, snap points, nested stacking, indent effect, swipe-to-open area and software-keyboard inset. Focus trap and focus return.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Drawer (side=top|right|bottom|left), DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription, DrawerBody, DrawerFooter, DrawerClose; optional DrawerGrip, DrawerSwipeArea, DrawerProvider/DrawerIndent/DrawerIndentBackground, DrawerVirtualKeyboardProvider, createDrawerHandle. Pass snapPoints to a side="bottom" Drawer. Pass keyboardAware to DrawerContent for sheets with fields. Motion: backdrop yorha-fade, popup yorha-slide-*; instant under data-motion off, opacity-only under reduced.
